entities.summary: Île Sainte-Marguerite is the largest of the Lérins Islands, about half a mile offshore from the French Riviera city of Cannes, situated in the Bay of Cannes. The island is approximately 3,200 metres in length and 950 metres across. Sainte Marguerite Island is the closest of the Lérins Islands to Cannes, just 700 metres from the Palm-Beach headland, and the most extensive, covering an area of 2.1 square kilometres. It reaches an altitude of only 27.6 metres in the north, near the fort.
